proof_status: Stage 4 — candidate proof architecture under named premises, without independent specialist verification and without theorem closure.
application_status_rule: An application of the framework is a conditional analysis, not evidence that the framework is true and not an upgrade of its proof status.

classification_options.name: fixed specification / PCL
classification_options.description: A finite governing boundary is held fixed relative to optimization; the relevant Stage 4 pressure is proxy-convergence/decoupling under the stated premises.

classification_options.name: bounded dynamic tracking / AGC
classification_options.description: A boundary updates adaptively at bounded cost; the relevant Stage 4 pressure is non-vanishing tracking/maintenance burden or adequacy loss under optimizer-generated novelty.

classification_options.name: prediction-action firewall / ICI
classification_options.description: Excluded variables remain available for prediction or instrumental policy influence while denied objective-governing status; the relevant Stage 4 pressure is representational incompatibility, audit regress, or recoupling.

classification_options.name: candidate fourth class
classification_options.description: A claimed architecture outside PCL, AGC, and ICI; it must survive the OP4d counterexample conditions rather than merely use a different label.

classification_options.name: insufficient information
classification_options.description: The optimizer, objective boundary, excluded variables, or maintenance mechanism is not specified well enough to justify structural classification.

method.name: Identify the optimizer or decision process
method.instruction: Name the actual policy, training process, oversight process, or persistent deployment loop being analyzed.

method.name: State the proposed objective
method.instruction: Separate the intended target from the concrete governing mechanism that makes it action-relevant.

method.name: Assess the environment and O_OWT applicability
method.instruction: Assess OWT-1 macroscopic causal perturbation, OWT-2 intervention-generated structural opacity/dependency growth, OWT-3 strategic/adaptive substrate, OWT-4 persistent optimization horizon, and OWT-5 reachable non-resettable state. Report supported, partly supported, not established, or not applicable.

method.name: Identify the objective boundary
method.instruction: State which variables/conditions count toward success and which remain outside objective governance.

method.name: List causally load-bearing excluded variables
method.instruction: Identify excluded variables that materially affect adequate prediction/action or the viability/identity of the intended target; do not invent them if none are established.

method.name: Identify the boundary-maintenance mechanism
method.instruction: Describe whether the boundary is fixed, dynamically updated, firewalled, recoupled, maintained by another mechanism, or unspecified.

method.name: Classify the strategy
method.instruction: Choose fixed specification/PCL, bounded dynamic tracking/AGC, prediction-action firewall/ICI, candidate fourth class, or insufficient information.

method.name: State the predicted structural pressure
method.instruction: Name the specific conditional pressure rather than a generic alignment risk.

method.name: State every premise
method.instruction: List domain, separability, excluded-variable, modeling-depth, scaling, and relevant PCL/AGC/ICI or empirical-hinge assumptions.

method.name: Separate evidence from extrapolation
method.instruction: Record what is demonstrated for the system separately from what is inferred conditionally from the framework.

method.name: Identify a falsifier
method.instruction: Name a formal or empirical result that would make the classification or predicted pressure wrong.

method.name: State the design decision that would change
method.instruction: Name a concrete conditional design or evaluation decision that follows if the analysis is correct.

method.name: Report framework status
method.instruction: Stage 4 — candidate proof architecture under named premises, without independent specialist verification and without theorem closure. State that the application itself does not upgrade this status.

method.name: Link primary sources
method.instruction: At minimum link The Stability Assumption and Proof Status; add OP4d, AMP, or the relevant Technical Companion when applicable.

worked_applications.title: RLHF and reward modeling
worked_applications.approach: A reward or preference model learned from human judgments guides policy optimization.
worked_applications.o_owt_assessment: Not established by RLHF alone. The application strengthens only insofar as the actual deployed or training/deployment system satisfies the relevant O_OWT conditions.
worked_applications.objective_boundary: The reward/preference model and encoded signals govern optimization success; adequacy-relevant aspects of the intended human target not represented as governing remain outside the boundary.
worked_applications.excluded_variables: System-specific human, institutional, environmental, or long-horizon causal variables that materially affect the intended target but are not objective-governing. A real application must identify them concretely.
worked_applications.boundary_maintenance_mechanism: Fixed reward/preference model during the analyzed optimization phase; updating or firewall variants require reclassification.
worked_applications.candidate_class: fixed specification / PCL (for the fixed-reward-model case)
worked_applications.predicted_pressure: Conditional proxy-convergence/decoupling as optimization and deployment alter causal conditions not captured by the fixed finite specification.
worked_applications.evidence_available: The canonical Stability Assumption and Related Work pages explicitly map RLHF/reward modeling to the fixed-specification/PCL pressure.
worked_applications.evidence_not_available: No demonstration here that a particular RLHF system fully satisfies O_OWT, has actually decoupled, or independently verifies the PCL scaling premises.
worked_applications.falsifier: Show that the fixed finite reward/preference boundary remains adequate under accurate fuller-information evaluation as modeling depth and intervention pressure rise without target decoupling, or show that the actual architecture is not fixed/separable and therefore requires reclassification.
worked_applications.possible_design_response: Measure reward-model adequacy under increasing deployment coupling; reclassify proposed dynamic updates as AGC candidates and explicit information gates as ICI candidates.
worked_applications.epistemic_status: Illustrative conditional application; not evidence that RLHF fails and not evidence that PCL is a closed theorem.

worked_applications.title: Scalable oversight or debate
worked_applications.approach: A bounded human or AI-assisted evaluative process attempts to preserve meaningful oversight as system capability increases.
worked_applications.o_owt_assessment: Architecture-specific. Strong application requires persistent coupled deployment with optimizer-generated environmental change and adaptive responses.
worked_applications.objective_boundary: The evaluator/decomposition defines what counts as acceptable or aligned; global or long-range consequences omitted from that bounded evaluation remain outside the governing boundary.
worked_applications.excluded_variables: System-specific global consequences, strategic responses, or model-known facts relevant to action quality but not adequately represented in the evaluator.
worked_applications.boundary_maintenance_mechanism: The evaluative process updates judgments/decompositions under finite resources; some designs also use an explicit prediction/action partition.
worked_applications.candidate_class: bounded dynamic tracking / AGC as the primary classification for updating oversight; ICI may be primary where a prediction/action firewall is explicit
worked_applications.predicted_pressure: Conditional non-vanishing tracking/maintenance burden or adequacy loss under optimizer-generated novelty; explicit firewalls may also face audit-regress pressure.
worked_applications.evidence_available: The Stability Assumption maps debate/oversight to bounded-tracking pressure and scalable oversight to boundary-maintenance pressure; Related Work identifies an ICI/audit-regress question.
worked_applications.evidence_not_available: No result establishes that every oversight architecture has the predicted burden; DBST-M1 has not yet run.
worked_applications.falsifier: Demonstrate a bounded evaluator maintaining adequacy comparable to an open/full-information evaluator under agent-action-generated novelty while relevant variation and maintenance burden vanish, or show that the architecture does not use the classified boundary mechanism.
worked_applications.possible_design_response: Specify update budget and omitted variables; compare bounded oversight with an open evaluator under equal resources and test any information firewall separately.
worked_applications.epistemic_status: Illustrative conditional application; not evidence that scalable oversight or debate fails.

worked_applications.title: Interpretability-based monitoring
worked_applications.approach: A monitor reads internal representations or other model-state information to detect or constrain misalignment.
worked_applications.o_owt_assessment: Deployment-specific; a static bounded diagnostic does not by itself establish the strongest domain.
worked_applications.objective_boundary: Rich internal information may be available for diagnosis while only approved findings or constraints are permitted to affect policy or objective governance.
worked_applications.excluded_variables: Internal/external facts represented for prediction or diagnosis but intended to remain non-governing except through a permitted audit channel.
worked_applications.boundary_maintenance_mechanism: A monitoring/audit layer decides which represented information matters for intervention while preserving the governing/non-governing partition.
worked_applications.candidate_class: prediction-action firewall / ICI as primary; AGC may apply if the monitor must update dynamically at bounded cost
worked_applications.predicted_pressure: Conditional audit regress/representational incompatibility; a dynamically changing monitor may also face non-vanishing boundary-maintenance pressure.
premises: persistent policy-relevant access to excluded information
ICI/B1 premises; AGC premises if dynamic tracking is claimed
worked_applications.evidence_available: The Stability Assumption explicitly maps interpretability-as-monitoring to firewall/audit-regress pressure; Related Work also connects monitoring to AGC.
worked_applications.evidence_not_available: No archive result establishes that every interpretability architecture enters audit regress or requires unbounded updating.
worked_applications.falsifier: Demonstrate a monitor that preserves needed policy-relevant predictive information while keeping excluded variables non-governing without audit regress, recoupling, or persistent maintenance burden under the relevant conditions.
worked_applications.possible_design_response: Audit the monitor and its adjudication rule as a boundary-maintenance system rather than assuming interpretability itself solves the specification problem.
worked_applications.epistemic_status: Illustrative conditional application; does not imply interpretability is useless or sufficient.

worked_applications.title: Corrigibility
worked_applications.approach: A system is intended to remain correctable by operators, including shutdown, modification, or correction.
worked_applications.o_owt_assessment: Cannot be inferred from the label; requires the actual deployment horizon, causal reach, adaptive environment, and non-resettable-state analysis.
worked_applications.objective_boundary: Not specified by corrigibility as a broad research goal; a concrete implementation must define the governing objective or policy constraint.
worked_applications.excluded_variables: Potentially the social, institutional, epistemic, and other substrate conditions that make correction possible, if a specific objective depends on them while leaving them outside governance.
worked_applications.boundary_maintenance_mechanism: Insufficient information without a concrete implementation.
worked_applications.predicted_pressure: The directly supported framework connection is substrate pressure: substrate-blind optimization may degrade conditions required for correction. PCL/AGC/ICI classification depends on the implementation.
premises: specific correction architecture needed before three-family classification
correction-enabling substrate must be causally load-bearing for any substrate-pressure application
worked_applications.evidence_available: Related Work explicitly distinguishes a system's disposition to accept correction from preservation of the environmental conditions that make correction possible.
worked_applications.evidence_not_available: No concrete objective-boundary architecture is supplied by the broad term corrigibility, so a definitive PCL/AGC/ICI classification would be invented.
worked_applications.falsifier: Supply a concrete architecture, which should replace the insufficient-information classification. For the substrate-pressure hypothesis, show that the alleged correction-enabling conditions remain preserved or are not causally load-bearing under the relevant interventions.
worked_applications.possible_design_response: Specify the operator, correction channel, correction-enabling substrate, governing objective, and boundary-maintenance mechanism before claiming structural coverage.
worked_applications.epistemic_status: Illustrative example of a deliberately withheld classification.

worked_applications.title: Hypothetical proof-carrying boundary as a candidate fourth strategy
worked_applications.approach: A finite objective G plus a fixed verifier V; excluded variables X can affect action ranking through certificates of admissibility while remaining declared outside objective satisfaction.
worked_applications.o_owt_assessment: Assume the full relevant coupled persistent domain for purposes of the OP4d counterexample stress test.
worked_applications.objective_boundary: G remains governing; X is excluded from satisfaction but can affect policy through certificate generation/verification.
worked_applications.excluded_variables: Adequacy-relevant X variables required for action evaluation while declared non-governing.
worked_applications.boundary_maintenance_mechanism: A fixed proof/certificate language and verifier mediate policy-relevant influence from X.
worked_applications.candidate_class: candidate fourth class — unresolved and included only as an adversarial test construction
worked_applications.predicted_pressure: The framework would test whether certificate admissibility reduces to ICI, proof obligations/semantics acquire AGC-style non-vanishing maintenance, fixed proof semantics become PCL-like, or X becomes functionally objective-governing recoupling.
premises: persistent policy-relevant causal influence from X
worked_applications.evidence_available: The construction superficially preserves policy-relevant influence from excluded variables while declaring them non-governing, satisfying only a surface part of the OP4d challenge.
worked_applications.evidence_not_available: No proof of OP4d A/B/C or L8 satisfaction, no proof of bounded/vanishing maintenance, no proof against audit regress or objective recoupling, and no empirical evidence.
worked_applications.falsifier: Fourth-class candidacy fails if external causal analysis reduces the certificate channel to PCL, AGC, ICI, or objective recoupling. A toy formal construction surviving OP4d A/B/C and the L8 challenge would instead materially challenge the present exhaustiveness architecture.
worked_applications.possible_design_response: Formalize the causal graph, certificate semantics, and resource/description-length scaling before treating the proposal as a new strategy class.
worked_applications.epistemic_status: Deliberately speculative stress-test construction; not an archive claim and not evidence that a fourth class exists.

allowed: proposal of formal counterexamples or empirical tests
not_allowed: report OP4 or OP4d as proved
assume every AI system satisfies O_OWT
treat PCL, AGC, and ICI as formally exhaustive before OP4d closes
use a broad research label as a substitute for specifying the actual objective boundary
use Series 3 phenomenology to upgrade Series 1 or Series 2 proof status
